record.summary: Apart from the twelve accepted deviations, which all appear as described, the render matches the reference.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panels. The Overview tab shows the Inbox, Queue and Context drift panels (R5, R6, R9) and no Chats panel: that is NCC-130's next PR (Chats, with its pager; LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: The Chats heading, search, tag chips, table and pager are absent. The page ends with empty background below Context drift.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Context drift. ncc check gives one line of text for each finding, with no repository and no kind, so the panel has a row for each finding (3 here) where the frame groups 22 findings by repository with a count and a chevron. The line over the rows says when the check ran and what it reads ("Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks."), where the frame has a clock time and other checks ("AGENTS.md length, links and folder layout"), which wait for a later check. The heading is PageHeader at its pane size, as Inbox and Queue are.
accepted_deviations.note: The count reads 3. There are three one-line rows with no counts and no chevrons, under "Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks."

accepted_deviations.as_given: Queue. "In progress" lists the open PRs with their pills, and no priority mark or owner chat on a row ("the-bridge#535" without "· bridge-workbench"): both come from Linear, which is out of scope. There is no "Up next" group, so the Queue counts its open PRs: 3 where the frame says 8, and "In progress" 3 where the frame says 4 over three rows.
accepted_deviations.note: The row titles start further left (about x 826 against 852) because the priority mark is gone. This is part of the deviation.

accepted_deviations.as_given: To review. The group shows as the frame draws it, closed with 17. On the live page it is empty until backend-coord decides how a chat's Inbox item names its project.
accepted_deviations.note: "TO REVIEW 17" is shown closed, with a right chevron.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panel headings. "Inbox" and "Queue" are PageHeader at its pane size (15 px, the count in mono), where the frame has an 18/24 heading and a 13 px count: no text style is 18 px (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: Because the headings are smaller, the panels start about 2 px higher, which is part of this deviation.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tabs. The tab row shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture, QA and Ideas, where the frame shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture and QA: only the tabs of shipped increments show (d-133). Repositories and Architecture are increment two's live slices, QA increment three's and Ideas increment one's, so Ideas comes after QA.
accepted_deviations.note: Ideas, with a lightbulb icon, comes after QA.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Row height. The Inbox rows are 56 px apart where the frame's are 58, so the Inbox panel is 6 px shorter and the closed "To review" row ends higher: the library's compact ListRow with a kind tile is 56 high (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Compact list row 58).
accepted_deviations.note: The rows sit at y 347, 403 and 459. The panel spans y 276 to 549 against 278 to 557 in the reference. Context drift sits about 8 px higher as a result.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Quick chat shows as the frame draws it; no frame draws its composer, so it is the library Dialog on every size, and in a state it opens nothing.

Owner's name. NCC-1701's purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace", where the frame has the owner's name: the secret scan's personal-term rule keeps the name out of web/. The live page shows the brain's own words.
accepted_deviations.note: The rest of the purpose line matches the reference word for word.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Top. The back row with Quick chat, the picture, the name and the purpose sit 4 px higher than the frame's: the page starts 24 down, as the home does, where the frame has 28, which no spacing token has. The tabs are where the frame draws them, so the gap above them is 4 px larger.
accepted_deviations.note: Projects sits at y 39 against 43 and the tabs are at y 186 in both pictures.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Rail. The rail is the app's shared one in the default order (d-105, d-119): Inbox, Workspaces, Projects, Artifacts, Toolkit and More. The frame draws an older rail with Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More. The page never changes the shared rail (pages/projects/AGENTS.md).
Sides. The page has 40 px sides, as the home has, where the frame has 36, so the header and the tabs are 4 px right of the frame's.
accepted_deviations.note: The content's left edge is at x 104 against 100 and its right edge at 1472 against 1476. The panels, Quick chat, Run check and the pills move with it.

limits: The full-page images (1512 x 1530) may have been shown to me scaled down, so I could not check differences under about 2 px below the 420 px top crop.
